mn80:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
mn80:2.1: atha kho vekhanasso paribbājako yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.
mn80:2.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi.
mn80:2.3: ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho vekhanasso paribbājako bhagavato santike udānaṃ udānesi:
mn80:2.5: kiṃ pana tvaṃ kaccāna, evaṃ vadesi:
mn80:2.8: yasmā bho gotama vaṇṇā añño vaṇṇo uttaritaro vā paṇītataro vā natthi, so paramo vaṇṇoti.
mn80:2.9: katamo pana so kaccāna, vaṇṇo yasmā vaṇṇā añño vaṇṇo uttaritaro vā paṇītataro vā natthīti?
mn80:2.10: yasmā bho gotama, vaṇṇā añño vaṇṇo uttaritaro vā paṇītataro vā natthi, so paramo vaṇṇoti.
mn80:3.1: dīghāpi kho te esā kaccāna, phareyya.
mn80:3.2: yasmā bho gotama, vaṇṇā añño vaṇṇo uttaritaro vā paṇītataro vā natthi. so paramo vaṇṇoti vadesi. tañca vaṇṇaṃ na paññāpesi.
mn80:3.4: ahaṃ yā imasmiṃ janapade janapadakalyāṇī, taṃ icchāmi taṃ kāmemī’ti.
mn80:3.6: ambho purisa, yaṃ tvaṃ janapadakalyāṇiṃ icchasi kāmesi, jānāsi tvaṃ janapadakalyāṇī khattiyī vā brāhmaṇī vā vessī vā suddī vā’ti?
mn80:3.9: ambho purisa, yaṃ tvaṃ janapadakalyāṇiṃ icchasi kāmesi, jānāsi tavaṃ janapadakalyāṇiṃ evannāmā evaṃgottā iti vā’ti. …pe… dīghā vā rassā vā majjhimā vā kāḷī vā sāmā vā maṅguracchavī vā’ti? amukasmiṃ gāme vā nigame vā nagare vā’ti?
mn80:3.12: ambho purisa, yaṃ tvaṃ na jānāsi na passasi, taṃ tvaṃ icchasi kāmesīti?
mn80:3.15: nanu evaṃ sante tassa purisassa appāṭihīrakataṃ bhāsitaṃ sampajjatīti?
mn80:3.16: addhā kho bho gotama, evaṃ sante tassa purisassa appāṭihīrakataṃ bhāsitaṃ sampajjatīti.
mn80:3.17: evameva kho tvaṃ kaccāna, yasmā bho gotama vaṇṇā añño vaṇṇo uttaritaro vā paṇītataro vā natthi, so paramo vaṇṇo’ti vadesi, tañca vaṇṇaṃ na paññāpesīti.
mn80:4.1: seyyathāpi bho gotama, maṇi veḷuriyo subho jātimā aṭṭhaṃso suparikammakato paṇḍukambale nikkhitto bhāsati ca tapati ca virocati ca evaṃvaṇṇo attā hoti arogo parammaraṇāti.
mn80:5.2: yo vā maṇi veḷuriyo subho jātimā aṭṭhaṃso suparikammakato paṇḍukambale nikkhitto bhāsati ca tapati ca virocati ca, yo vā rattandhakāratimisāyaṃ kimi khajjopaṇako, imesaṃ ubhinnaṃ vaṇṇānaṃ katamo vaṇṇo abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro cāti?
mn80:5.3: yvāyaṃ bho gotama, rattandhakāratimisāyaṃ kimi khajjopaṇako ayaṃ imesaṃ ubhinnaṃ vaṇṇānaṃ abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro cāti.
mn80:6.2: yo vā rattandhakāratimisāyaṃ kimi khajjopaṇako, yo vā rattandhakāratimisāyaṃ telappadīpo, imesaṃ ubhinnaṃ vaṇṇānaṃ katamo vaṇṇo abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro cāti?
mn80:6.3: yvāyaṃ bho gotama, rattandhakāratimisāyaṃ telappadīpo, ayaṃ imesaṃ ubhinnaṃ vaṇṇānaṃ abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro cāti.
mn80:7.2: yo vā rattandhakāratimisāyaṃ telappadīpo, yo vā rattandhakāratimisāyaṃ mahāaggikkhandho, imesaṃ ubhinnaṃ vaṇṇānaṃ katamo vaṇṇo abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro cāti?
mn80:7.3: yvāyaṃ bho gotama, rattandhakāratimisāyaṃ mahāaggikkhandho, ayaṃ imesaṃ ubhinnaṃ vaṇṇānaṃ abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro cāti.
mn80:8.2: yo vā rattandhakāratimisāyaṃ mahāaggikkhandho, yā vā rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ viddhe vigatavalāhake deve osadhītārakā, imesaṃ ubhinnaṃ vaṇṇānaṃ katamo vaṇṇo abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro cāti?
mn80:8.3: yvāyaṃ bho gotama, rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ viddhe vigatavalāhake deve osadhītārakā, ayaṃ imesaṃ ubhinnaṃ vaṇṇānaṃ abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro cāti.
mn80:9.2: yā vā rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ viddhe vigatavalāhake deve osadhītārakā, yo vā tadahuposathe paṇṇarase viddhe vigatavalāhake deve abhido aḍḍharattisamayaṃ cando, imesaṃ ubhinnaṃ vaṇṇānaṃ katamo vaṇṇo abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro cāti?
mn80:9.3: yvāyaṃ bho gotemā, tadahuposathe paṇṇarase viddhe vigatavalāhake deve abhido aḍḍharattisamayaṃ cando, ayaṃ imesaṃ ubhinnaṃ vaṇṇānaṃ abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro cāti.
mn80:10.2: yo vā tadahuposathe paṇṇarase viddhe vigatavalāhake deve abhido aḍḍharattisamayaṃ cando, yo vā vassānaṃ pacchime māse saradasamaye viddhe vigatavalāhake deve abhido majjhantikasamayaṃ suriyo, imesaṃ ubhinnaṃ vaṇṇānaṃ katamo vaṇṇo abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro cāti?
mn80:10.3: yvāyaṃ bho gotama, vassānaṃ pacchime māse saradasamaye viddhe vigatavalāhake deve abhido majjhantikasamayaṃ suriyo, ayaṃ imesaṃ ubhinnaṃ vaṇṇānaṃ abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro cāti.
mn80:11.1: ato kho te kaccāna, bahū hi bahutarā devā, ye imesaṃ candimasuriyānaṃ ābhā nānubhonti, tyāhaṃ pajānāmi.
mn80:11.3: yasmā vaṇṇā añño vaṇṇo uttaritaro ca paṇītataro ca natthīti.
mn80:11.4: atha ca pana tvaṃ kaccāna, yvāyaṃ vaṇṇo kiminā khajjopaṇakena hīnataro ca patikiṭṭhataro ca so paramo vaṇṇoti vadesi, tañca vaṇṇaṃ na paññāpesi.
mn80:12.3: cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
mn80:12.7: kāyaviññeyyā phoṭṭhabbā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
mn80:13.1: yaṃ kho kaccāna, ime pañca kāmaguṇe paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ, idaṃ vuccati kāmasukhaṃ.
mn80:13.2: iti kāmehi kāmasukhaṃ, kāmasukhā kāmaggasukhaṃ tattha aggamakkhāyatīti.
mn80:14.1: evaṃ vutte vekhanasso paribbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
mn80:14.2: acchariyaṃ bho gotama, abbhutaṃ bho gotama,
mn80:14.6: dujjānaṃ kho etaṃ kaccāna, tayā aññadiṭṭhikena aññakhantikena aññarucikena aññatrayogena aññathācariyakena
mn80:14.7: kāmā vā kāmasukhaṃ vā kāmaggasukhaṃ vā.
mn80:14.8: ye kho te kaccāna, bhikkhū arahanto khīṇāsavā vusitavanto katakaraṇīyā ohitabhārā anuppattasadatthā parikkhīṇabhavasaṃyojanā sammadaññā vimuttā, te kho etaṃ jāneyyuṃ
mn80:14.9: kāmā vā kāmasukhaṃ vā kāmaggasukhaṃ vāti.
mn80:15.1: evaṃ vutte vekhanasso paribbājako kupito anattamano bhagavantaṃyeva khuṃsento bhagavantaṃyeva vambhento bhagavantaṃyeva vadamāno
mn80:15.2: samaṇo ca gotamo pāpito bhavissatī’ti bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
mn80:15.3: evameva panidheke samaṇabrāhmaṇā ajānantā pubbantaṃ, apassantā aparantaṃ, atha ca pana:
mn80:15.4: khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti pajānāmā’ti paṭijānanti
mn80:15.5: tesamidaṃ bhāsitaṃ hassakaṃyeva sampajjati, lāmakaṃyeva sampajjati, rittakaṃyeva sampajjati, tucchakaṃyeva sampajjatī’ti.
mn80:16.1: ye kho te kaccāna, samaṇabrāhmaṇā ajānantā pubbantaṃ apassantā aparantaṃ
mn80:16.2: khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāmā’ti paṭijānanti,
mn80:16.4: api ca kaccāna, tiṭṭhatu pubbanto, tiṭṭhatu aparanto.
mn80:16.5: etu viññū puriso asaṭho amāyāvī ujujātiko ahamanusāsāmi, ahaṃ dhammaṃ desemi,
mn80:16.6: yathānusiṭṭhaṃ tathā paṭipajjamāno na cirasseva sāmaññeva ñassati, sāmaṃ dakkhiti.
mn80:16.7: evaṃ kira sammā bandhanā vippamokkho hoti yadidaṃ avijjābandhanā.
mn80:16.8: seyyathāpi kaccāna, daharo kumāro mando uttānaseyyako kaṇṭhapañcamehi bandhanehi baddho assa suttabandhanehi,
mn80:16.9: tassa vuddhimanvāya indriyānaṃ paripākamanvāya tāni bandhanāni mucceyyuṃ
mn80:16.10: so mokkhomhīti kho jāneyya no ca bandhanaṃ.
mn80:16.11: evameva kho kaccāna, etu viññū puriso asaṭho amāyāvī ujujātiko. ahamanusāsāmi, ahaṃ dhammaṃ desemi.
mn80:16.12: yathānusiṭṭhaṃ tathā paṭipajjamāno na cirasseva sāmaññe ñassati. sāmaṃ dakkhiti.
mn80:16.13: evaṃ kira sammā bandhanā vippamokkho hoti yadidaṃ avijjābandhanāti.
mn80:17.1: evaṃ vutte vekhanaso paribbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
mn80:17.2: abhikkantaṃ bho gotama abhikkantaṃ bho gotama, …pe…
mn80:17.3: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṅgatanti.
